static_traits.name: Natalie
static_traits.social_status: 有朋友可倾诉,但not yet与朋友分享自己的恋爱情感;社交与表达受困难影响
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病;not yet接受过心理治疗;此前恋爱关系without类似心理困扰
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,配合度高;开场略感紧张但Positive attitude;能描述自动化思维与trigger情境;愿意执行记录与Homework

basic_info.main_problem: 我因一段浪漫关系相关的负性思维而困扰.我相信这个夏天我爱上的人并not回应我的感情,并且永远not会爱我.
basic_info.core_demands: 我厌倦了这种感觉,只想找到一些平静,并且在与TA相处时not再如此Anxiety;同时改善情绪和Learning表现.

core_beliefs: I am not worthy of being loved

special_situations.event: Seeing a crush at school or trying to interact with them
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果对方have not立刻热情回应或表现出明显兴趣,就说明他们not在乎我/讨厌我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避表达真实感受,Repression和分散注意以试图控制负性思维
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她一定讨厌我;她永远not会爱我

special_situations.event: 心仪对象have not及时回复消息
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果信息not yet被及时回复,就代表对方not在乎我或在疏远我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少主动联系,Suppressing expression冲动,通过分散注意力来避开情绪

special_situations.event: The other person seeming distracted when talking to one's crush或注意力not集中
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果对方聊天时not够专注,就说明对我have not任何感觉
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 立刻Withdrawal,减少接近与互动以避免Being rejected

special_situations.event: 开学后Increased stress且not知如何表达感情
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能完美地表达感受,就一定会Being rejected并让关系变得尴尬
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 放弃表白或推进关系,Repression情感并选择not去面对
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: not管我怎么做,她都not会爱我

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be liked, accepted, and to build intimate relationships
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected,被讨厌以及关系变得尴尬
defense_goal: 通过保持疏离与Suppressing expression来降低Being rejected的风险,维持表面安全感

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的追求者/可能Being rejected者
object_relations.object_representation: Cold others who may reject me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether I express feelings or when faced with encouragement to do reality testing and behavioral experiments
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client regards expressing needs as a high-risk event, subconsciously believing expression will bring rejection and embarrassment
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和且验证其Fear,先从低风险的间接表达练习(如写下not yet发送的信息,Role playing)入手,避免逼迫其立即表白;use短句,慢节奏,强调可控与选择权.

manifestations: 担心对方not爱自己,not yet向朋友分享真实感受,害怕表达后Being rejected导致Distant relationships
outcomes: Difficulty establishing connections with significant others

manifestations: Decreased interest in activities I originally enjoyed (summer walks, reading)

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: not表达对心仪对象的喜欢,强行Repression和分散注意力以'自己处理'
在互动中选择Withdrawal而非寻求外部支持

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 将自己的not安与not值得被爱的感受,归因为对方'讨厌我''not在乎我'
据少量线索(not yet及时回复,Distraction)认定他人负面态度

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁Self-doubt与'I am not good enough'的自责叙事
Overly cautious, worrying that expression will cause embarrassment and thus limiting one's actions

exception_events.target_problem: 在学校看到或与心仪对象互动时,来访者通常会陷入灾难化与读心术的负性思维,随之Low mood并回避表达.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在暑假里有几次一起外出或相处的情境中,来访者have not像往常那样完全Withdrawal,而是与对方互动并注意到对方并not yet回避自己,这让她的心情稍有缓解.
exception_events.reason: 线索:not同情境(暑假较为放松的环境),not同支持(对方有积极回应:会回复消息并愿意相处),not同做法(来访者主动参与互动而非完全回避),因此这次负性思维的强度降低.

positive_force: Willing to seek counseling and cooperate with recording tasks
There is positive interaction evidence (the other party replies to messages, is willing to spend time together)
Has friends as potential support resources
negative_force: Cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing, mind reading, and black-and-white thinking are marked
害怕Being rejected导致回避表达
反刍与Repression策略维持负性情绪

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly falls into negative automatic thoughts related to romantic situations and avoids expressing emotions
antecedent: Seeing or approaching their crush at school
心仪对象not yet及时回复信息
The other person seeming distracted when talking to one's crush
开学压力与not知如何表达感受
target_behavior.core_reason: 对Being rejected的强烈Fear与'非黑即白/灾难化'等认知偏差维持了负性反刍与回避
target_behavior.function: 逃避可能的拒绝与尴尬,从而短时缓解Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 情绪持续低落与Anxiety,Learning成绩下降,社交受限,对原本喜欢的活动Reduced interest
